summary: 末代之主，勤政十七年而回天无术；杀袁崇焕自毁长城，甲申之变李自成入京，煤山自缢，明亡。
summary_en: The last Ming emperor, diligent for seventeen years in a lost cause; he executed Yuan Chonghuan and broke his own shield; in 1644 Li Zicheng took Beijing and he hanged himself on Coal Hill.

bio_md:
# 明思宗朱由检 · 主要事迹

朱由检（1611—1644），[[ming-guang-zong|光宗]]之子，[[ming-xi-zong|熹宗]]弟，天启七年（1627）即位，改元崇祯。

崇祯帝勤政十七年，鸡鸣而起、夜分不寐，然性刚愎多疑，十七年间更易内阁首辅五十余人、诛督师七人。崇祯三年（1630）中反间计杀袁崇焕，自毁长城；对内剿抚不定，李自成、张献忠之乱燎原；崇祯十七年（1644）三月，李自成破居庸关入北京，帝登煤山自缢，遗书「任贼分裂朕尸，勿伤百姓」，明亡。

其后清兵入关，定鼎中原（[[qing-shi-zu|清世祖]]即位）。思宗以勤政亡国之身殉社稷，「亡国之君而克己若此」，为史家所叹。

bio_parts_en.value:
, took the throne in 1627, era Chongzhen.

For seventeen years he rose before dawn and worked past midnight - yet he was rigid and suspicious, replacing more than fifty chief secretaries and executing seven commanders. In 1630, deceived by a ruse, he executed Yuan Chonghuan and broke his own shield. Against the rebels he wavered between suppression and pardon while Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong spread fire across the land. In March 1644 Li Zicheng took Beijing; the emperor climbed Coal Hill and hanged himself, leaving his body to the rebels but pleading for his people. The Ming fell.

The Qing then entered the passes and took the realm (
). A diligent emperor who died with his state - "no fallen sovereign ever ruled so frugally," the histories sigh.
